answer_1.quote: We started with the raw EHR data and extracted the discharge notes. These discharge notes are summarized using an instruction‑tuned LLM. Three types of prompts, plain, riskfactor, and timeline, were used to produce different types of summaries...
datasets: Psychiatric discharge notes from four hospitals (McLean, MGH, BWH, FH)
answer_1.outputs: Paragraph‑length summaries of discharge notes conditioned on aspect‑oriented prompts
